newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms falls 3.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms falls 3.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 3.4 percent year-on-year in December, the national statistics institute ISTAT said.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 74.2 (1988=100) in December, with month-on-month employment down 1.3 percent from November.

For the January-December 1996 period, employment fell 2.1 percent over the same period in 1995, ISTAT said. Hours worked per employee was unchanged compared to December 1995 after a fall of 2.7 percent year-on-year in November.
Istat said the sectors most affected in December by the fall in employment were mining, chemicals and metalworking.
